title: Endomorphism fibres: additive coordinates, coherent shifts and strict augmentations
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], with integer cochain complexes, cones and shifts as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Consider the category whose objects are pairs $(V,s)$ with $V$ a cochain complex and $s:V\to V$ a chain endomorphism, and whose morphisms $a:(V,s)\to(W,t)$ are chain maps satisfying $as=ta$, with componentwise composition and addition. Set $K(V,s)=\operatorname{Cone}(s)[-1]$. The reordered cone coordinates identify
$$K(V,s)^q=V^q\oplus V^{q-1},\qquad d(v,u)=(dv,-du-sv).$$
The diagonal formula $K(a)(v,u)=(av,au)$ defines an additive functor on this category. Shifting $(V,s)$ means $(V[r],s[r])$. There are coherent natural chain isomorphisms
$$\sigma_{(V,s),r}:K(V[r],s[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}K(V,s)[r],\qquad(v,u)\mapsto(v,(-1)^r u)$$
for every integer $r$, with inverse given by the same coordinate formula. Under the canonical degree reindexings, $\sigma_0$ is the identity and the successive comparisons for $r$ and $r'$ agree with the comparison for $r+r'$.
For every complex $M$ and chain map $J:M\to V$ with $sJ=0$, the formula $\eta_J(m)=(Jm,0)$ is a chain map $M\to K(V,s)$. If $a:(V,s)\to(W,t)$, $J':M'\to W$ satisfies $tJ'=0$, and $g:M\to M'$ satisfies $aJ=J'g$, then $K(a)\eta_J=\eta_{J'}g$. For every $r$ the same specified shift comparison satisfies
$$\sigma_{(V,s),r}\eta_{J[r]}=\eta_J[r].$$
These formulas are identities of biproduct component morphisms and apply without boundedness or exactness assumptions.

proof.text: The cocone projections and inclusions give an explicit biproduct isomorphism: lift the two projections and descend the two inclusions. Their four composites and the cocone identity decomposition prove the inverse equations. The first differential coordinate is the chain-map equation for fst. Expand the shifted mapping-cone second projection and apply Mathlib mappingCone.d_snd_v to obtain the second differential coordinate.

proof.text: Specialize the diagonal cocone map inclusion formulas of [lem-weil-signed-mapping-cocone-shift]. Testing on both inclusions proves preservation of addition and the two projection coordinates of every intertwiner. Specialize its signed comparison inclusion formulas to the identity forgetful comparisons. Cancel the forward isomorphism to deduce the inverse formulas, using the square of the parity sign. Its zero and addition laws give the required coherence.

proof.text: The annihilation equation makes the zero-second-cochain mappingCocone.lift condition vanish. Mathlib lift projection equations give augmentation coordinates (J,0). The cocone identity decomposition proves that projections jointly determine an incoming map; together with the intertwiner coordinates this proves augmentation naturality. Shift the annihilation equation by the additive shift functor. A map with zero second projection equals its first projection followed by the first inclusion; applying the forward signed comparison inclusion equation then identifies the shifted augmentation with the shift of the original lift.

I recomputed every step. Step 1: intertwiners are closed under composition and sums. Step 2: Cone(s)[−1] reordered gives D(v,u)=(dv,−du−sv), and D²=(0,dsv−sdv)=0. Step 3: diag(a,a) is a chain map by ad=da and ta=as, and is additive. Step 4: both composites with σ_r give (εdv,−du−εsv), and ε²=1 gives the inverse. Step 5: naturality gives (av,εau), σ_0=id, and σ_r and σ_{r'} compose to σ_{r+r'}, including negative shifts. Step 6: η_J is a chain map by sJ=0, the naturality is (aJ,0)=(J'g,0), and σ η_{J[r]}=η_J[r]. Edge cases checked: V=0, s=0, s=1, r=−1, shifts 1 then −1, Z--2-->Z with s=3, and characteristic 2. The parent lem-pe-roos-cone-calculus steps 1 and 5 use exactly these clauses. lem-weil-signed-mapping-cocone-shift (another unit) generalizes only the shift clause, so this is not a duplicate. lem-amb-signed-fibre-shift concerns functors to Ab, and lem-pe-endomorphism-fibre-double-cone is a sibling. Calling all six steps elementary is right: each is a few-line biproduct calculation. All four search kinds are recorded. Delivery-errors A–F are clean. No fixes and no tool_uses.
